text: It works one month, then stops?
spoken: Is your marketing built, or patched? Here's an easy test.
visual: One cloth square on ivory paper with one odd scrap sewn on alone, its corner lifting off

text: "Try a new channel." No. Stop patching.
spoken: Your channel's fine. Every fix you tried got patched on alone.
visual: A new scrap labelled with no brand lands on the cloth beside three loose old ones

text: Tried everything? Each fix stood alone.
spoken: You shouldn't add one more fix. Build on the last one.
visual: Three mismatched scraps pinned on the cloth, none touching

text: Cold email. Ads. LinkedIn. Never built together.
spoken: Stop patching your months with cold email, ads, then LinkedIn.
visual: Three scraps with plain labels sewn on one at a time, gaps between them

text: Did your last fix use what the one before learned?
spoken: I can tell if your marketing will hold from one question.
visual: One scrap held against the cloth, a big question mark stitched in thread beside it

text: It's not LinkedIn. It's the patch.
spoken: You say LinkedIn works, but it's sporadic. Here's the real reason.
visual: A cloth with one scrap sewn on alone, the thread already loose

text: Built or patched? One easy test.
spoken: Some months three clients, some months nothing? Your fixes were patched.
visual: A calendar-shaped cloth, full squares and bare squares, one scrap sewn over a bare one

text: LinkedIn works, but it's sporadic. Here's why.
spoken: Why did your last fix stop working? It was a patch.
visual: One scrap sewn on alone, pulling away at the corner

text: Your next fix should use what the last learned.
spoken: The only fix that holds is built on your last one.
visual: Two scraps: one cut from the same cloth, one odd one

text: Tried everything. Nothing stuck. Here's why.
spoken: Your best fix won't be new. It's built from your last.
visual: A pile of odd scraps beside one cloth with no patch
